subject: English
question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in column 'A' and column
stimulus: 'B' to write five complete sentences. There are more parts of sentences in column 'B' than required. 1×5=5 Column A Column B (a) It is true that mother is (i) touch our mother enormously. (b) The sweet name is entangled (ii) my head bows down. (c) Our happiness and (iii) the highest place. sorrows first (d) Every religion gives mother (iv) the sweetest word. (e) According to Prophet (v) to the child until (Sm) heaven lies death. (vi) at the feet of mother. (vii) with our existence.
guide_solution: Matching (a) + (iv) It is true that mother is the sweetest word. (b) + (v) The sweet name is entangled to the child until death (c) + (i) Our happiness and sorrows first touch our mother enormously. (d) + (iii) Every religion gives mother the highest place. (e) + (vi) According to our Prophet (SM), heaven lies at the feet of mother.
